title: Coalesce durability acknowledgement for concurrent identical unfinished evidence reads
outcome: Concurrent identical unfinished reads return the same durable reply without transient target-change conflicts or duplicate tracker IO.
acceptance: Two identical unfinished reads while the production persistence writer is held coalesce or accept the same confirmed target; after acknowledgement both return the same original unfinished result, with no duplicated tracker IO and no allowance reset.
A stepped-writer behavioral regression covers concurrent unfinished replay, acknowledgement failure/retry and target replacement fencing.
